g.text: One-bedroom module / eight ground instances / 72 m² gross / clear dimensions between finished faces
For Blender blockout / proposed / not an as-built playable
Dimensions govern. All lengths in metres unless marked mm. Print A1 at 100%.
MAP REV 01 + DETAIL ISSUE B01 / 18 OCTOBER 2026
External shell 200 mm. Partitions 120 mm. FFL 0.00; clear ceiling
+2.80, next FFL +3.00. Shell fits inside the 9 × 8 footprint. Slab
top equals FFL; do not add slab thickness above it.
D01/D02 are 1.10 clear and share a 1.50 clear hall. Hall centre is
x=0.95; openings x=0.40–1.50. Door leaves are held open in the first
blockout. Bedrooms/bathrooms are optional, not the through route.
Room dimensions exclude walls. Furniture is an allowance, not
another collider owner. Preserve cross-hall and door sweeps. Window
sill 0.90, head 2.25; closed glazing. Southern instances mirror
ROOM TAGS AND OPENINGS: use the local coordinates in build-spec.json. Each placed portal is listed in
home-openings.csv with world position, width and head height. Door arcs are modelling guides; working-
